markdown:
Think I'm finally 'done' with #Wardogs. Everything costs so much to unlock and you almost earn no money. I unlocked the Minigun Heli Bird (125k), and then almost immediatly died to Galil to the face. Then had another bad run and just ended with 1800 bucks. Joined a European server and no revives.. 

The economy is totally wack now and between the people grinding semi-exploits and the rest too scared to buy anything or do anything (just leeching) it's become an annoying game.

Hopefully I can now spend some time on Transport Fever 3. Or back to building my own games..
